en.headline: Cathay Pacific to launch direct flights to Almaty from January 2027
en.dek: The three-times-weekly service will be the airline’s first Central Asian destination and the only non-stop link between Hong Kong and Kazakhstan, subject to regulatory approval.
body: Cathay Pacific Airways announced on Thursday that it will launch direct passenger flights between Hong Kong and Almaty, Kazakhstan’s largest city, starting on 9 January 2027. The service will operate three times a week on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays using Airbus A330-300 aircraft.

The airline said Almaty marks its first destination in Central Asia and will provide the only non-stop passenger link between Hong Kong and Kazakhstan. Flight time is expected to be about six to seven hours each way. Tickets are already available for purchase on the airline’s website, subject to regulatory approval.

Cathay Pacific described Almaty as an important gateway to Central Asia for trade, business and tourism, adding that the route reinforces Hong Kong’s position as an international aviation hub and supports connectivity along the Belt and Road.

zh.headline: 國泰明年1月開通阿拉木圖直航 成中亞首個航點
zh.dek: 每周三班服務將成為國泰首個中亞目的地，亦是香港與哈薩克之間唯一直航客運航線，尚待當局批准。
body: 國泰航空周四宣布，將於2027年1月9日起開通香港至哈薩克最大城市阿拉木圖的直航客運服務。航線每周三班，逢星期二、四及六以空中巴士A330-300客機營運。
國泰指阿拉木圖是其首個中亞航點，亦是香港與哈薩克之間唯一直航客運航線。單程飛行時間約六至七小時。機票已可於航空公司網站預訂，惟仍須待有關當局批准。
國泰表示，阿拉木圖是通往中亞的重要門戶，有助拓展貿易、商務及旅遊，新航線亦進一步鞏固香港作為國際航空樞紐的地位，並加強「一帶一路」沿線的連通性。
